items.heading: Removing footwear before entering the house
details: Reduces soil, dust, and outdoor contaminants from being tracked into living areas.

items.heading: Washing feet before entering the house or puja area
details: Feet collect dust, pollen, pollution, and countless microbes while outside.
Washing them before entering prevents tracking outside dirt and germs onto clean indoor surfaces.

items.heading: Bathing before entering a temple
details: Removes sweat, dirt, and some contaminants before entering a shared place of worship.

items.heading: Separate footwear for toilet / bathroom areas
details: Helps prevent the transfer of contaminants from wet, high-germ areas to the rest of the home.

items.heading: Sun-drying bedding and mattresses
details: Reduces moisture in bedding and can reduce some microorganisms through heat and UV exposure.
